name: Personal · family
for: a household with children: two earners, a home, a car, school and childcare

accounts.description: Household income from everyone in the family
Salaries and work income of the adults, one account per earner
Salary of the first earner (rename to the person); tax and social security withheld post to Taxes
Salary of the second earner (rename to the person)
Bonuses, overtime, freelance and side jobs
Money from the state and refunds not tied to one expense

accounts.path: Income:Benefits and refunds:Child benefit and allowances
accounts.description: Child benefit, parental-leave pay, family allowances
Refunds from the annual return; or credit the tax account if you prefer net figures
Savings and investment returns
Savings interest, bond coupons, dividends
Realised gains on investments and rent from property you let
Everything else that comes in
Money gifts from family, birthday money for the kids
Second-hand sales, cashback, rewards, prizes
Household spending; groups follow COICOP 2018 divisions and GnuCash's common accounts
The home: mortgage interest or rent, taxes, insurance, upkeep (COICOP 04, 05)
Interest part of the mortgage payment; the principal reduces the mortgage liability and is not an expense
Rent and letting fees
Property tax (IMI, IPTU, council tax) and condominium or HOA fees
Buildings and contents insurance
Repairs, gardener, cleaner, handyman
Furniture, appliances, decoration, tools
Running the home (COICOP 04.4, 04.5, 08.3)
Electricity, gas, heating oil, district heating
Water, sewage, refuse collection
Broadband, TV packages and the family's mobile plans
Food at home versus food away from home (COICOP 01, 11.1)
Supermarkets, markets, bulk stores
Restaurants and cafés
Food ordered in or picked up
Costs that exist because of the kids (COICOP 10, 13.3); their share of food, housing and holidays stays in those groups
Daycare, nursery, nanny, babysitters, after-school care
Tuition, enrolment fees, tutoring
Books, stationery, uniforms, school lunches, excursions
Clubs, music lessons, sports, summer camps
Kids' clothes and shoes, diapers, formula, baby gear
Money handed to the kids to spend as they like
The car and getting around (COICOP 07)
Fuel or charging, parking, tolls
Servicing, tyres, repairs
Interest part of a car loan (the principal reduces the liability) or lease payments
Vehicle tax (IUC, IPVA), registration, inspection
Passes, tickets, taxis and ride-hailing
Health care for the whole family (COICOP 06)
Private health insurance premiums or plan contributions
GP, paediatrician, specialists, exams
Medicines, glasses, contact lenses, medical supplies
Psychotherapy, speech therapy, counselling
Animals in the house (COICOP 09.3)
Veterinary care, pet insurance, grooming, boarding
The adults' own things (COICOP 03, 13.1)
Adults' clothes and shoes; the kids' are under Children
Hair, cosmetics, toiletries
Gym, classes, sports gear, hobbies
Courses, training and books for the adults
Time off together (COICOP 09, 11.2)
Flights, hotels, packages, spending while away
Cinema, zoo, museums, theme parks, events, books, music and games
Streaming, apps, memberships
Money that goes to other people
Birthday and holiday gifts, kids' parties, weddings
Help sent to parents and other relatives
Banks, interest and insurance not tied to the home, car or health (COICOP 12)
